findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional — Close now stops after three rounds when an open below-bar finding has Harm 3 (close.py:249; score.py:123–124). This question builds its rows only from `blocking(result)`. With a new at-bar Harm 1 finding and an open Harm 3 follow-up, the owner is asked to accept, narrow or split without seeing the finding responsible for the stop; Accept also dismisses that unlisted finding.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done — An area stop counts findings from earlier rounds through `known`, but `move` looks for `Raise: Security` only in the current result. If an earlier security finding and two later findings reach the third distinct finding in that area, the proposal starts with cutting code instead of fail closed. This is a different case from the earlier scored Harm 4 finding in the current round, which this branch fixes.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done — When the coordinator dismisses a below-bar finding with evidence in its first round, `_settled` records `dismissed because ...`; `_accepted` includes only reasons starting `known:` or `accepted by the owner:`. The next review's `$accepted` block therefore omits this earlier below-bar finding and its scores, although item 3 requires every earlier below-bar finding there. The added prompt test covers an undismissed below-bar finding.
